caption: Two batteries are slid into a flashlight whose switch is already on, and the light comes on as the cap is screwed down.

sa.check: A flashlight with its cap off and its switch on.
Two batteries are slid into the flashlight.
The light comes on as the cap closes.
The flashlight is dark before the cap is screwed down.
The order is batteries in, cap on, light.

pc.expect: The light comes on as the cap closes on the barrel, and only then; it stays dark with the batteries in but the cap off.
pc.fail: The light comes on as the batteries slide in with the cap still off; or the cap is screwed down and the light stays dark to the end of the clip; or the light is on before the batteries go in; or the light comes on with the cap lying loose.

pc.expect: Once on, the light stays on steadily while the cap stays screwed down.
pc.fail: The light goes out again with the cap on; or flickers; or the cap unscrews itself; or the beam fades to dark.

pc.expect: The lit lens throws a beam: the surface it points at brightens.
pc.fail: The lens glows while the surface it points at stays as dark as before; or the surface brightens while the lens stays dark; or the lit patch is behind the flashlight.

pc.expect: The batteries slide into the barrel along its axis; the cap turns on the barrel's thread and tightens.
pc.fail: A battery enters sideways through the barrel's wall; or the cap goes on without turning and then is shown screwed; or the barrel turns instead of the cap while the hand holds the barrel; or the cap turns and does not advance.

pc.expect: Two batteries inside one barrel; the batteries enter the open end and are hidden once in; the cap closes on the barrel; fingers pass through nothing.
pc.fail: A battery passes through the barrel's wall; or a third battery appears; or a battery vanishes in mid-air; or the cap merges with the barrel.

pc.expect: The flashlight's colour, the batteries' labels and the surface stay the same apart from the light.
pc.fail: The flashlight changes colour; or the batteries change size or label; or the surface changes.
